annotations.title: Import a film file from Vimeo

description: Copy an owner-authorized Vimeo MP4 or MOV download link directly into the connected creator's film storage. Create the film or series and its episode first, or use their existing IDs. Attaches the file to main, trailer (feature or series), or episode and replaces any current video in that slot upon completion. Call only for the intended destination. Poll get_upload_status with the returned upload_id. This tool never publishes the film.

asset.description: Defaults to main, or episode when episode_id is supplied. Trailer accepts a feature or series trailer.

download_url.description: The owner's authorized, direct Vimeo MP4 or MOV download URL, including its signature.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).

name: import_film_video_from_vimeo
